repository_commit_note: This is the tag spark-ds41f-1120. The lab ran a local branch on that tag, which added the profiles, the overlay, and four settings of its own (site_config_differences); that branch is not public.
image: The lab built spark-ds41f:1120 from the release's lock with bin/spark build prepare and build image.
image_digest_note: The digest of that build was not recorded with the runs.
hardware: Three DGX Spark nodes (GB10) at tensor parallel 3 over three direct RoCE cables, on kernel 7.0.0-1019-nvidia with 4 KiB pages.
site_config_differences: host.fan_control is false; the key is absent at the tag, and its default is true.
shapes.tp3-triangle-4k.environment.SPARK_DS41F_DISPLAY_CARVEOUT_WEIGHTS is "0", where the shape inherits "1"; the lab's UEFI display carve-out is 0.5 GB.
The glp block is removed, so the model ran without the GLP vector.
NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX is removed from shapes.tp3-triangle.environment, so NCCL finds the GID of each device by its address.
cluster_state_receipt: runs/tier-gates.jsonl, whose start-check records give the model name, the six series of the tier, the degraded reading 0, and the slot and bound lines of ranks 0 to 2.
